birth.note: doxologia.ro: «s-a născut în Roma, ca fiu al unui senator creștin cu numele Ioan… pe la jumătatea secolului al IV-lea» — about the middle of the fourth century. The interval is the quarter-century either side that reading allows; the page gives no year.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 23 octombrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Macarie Romanul»

attestations.note: His life closes «fiind pomenit în ziua de 23 octombrie», which is the day the calendar keeps him on.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Μακάριος ο Ρωμαίος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2789/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is plainly the same man: a Roman, son of a senatorial lord named John, married by his parents' force and gone on the wedding night. **The page opens by distrusting its own material** — «Η βιογραφία του Οσίου Μακαρίου από τους Συναξαριστές είναι πολύ μυθώδης και παράδοξη», the life of the venerable Macarius in the Synaxaristes is very mythical and strange — which is not the asterisk and not a doubt about the man, but is said here because it governs how much of the page is repeated. It gives no year at all, so the folder's existing `dates`, read from doxologia, are left untouched. The three monks it names, Sergius, Hyginus and Theophilus of the monastery of Saint Asklepios in Mesopotamia of Syria, answer to nothing in the corpus and get no `related` rows. No hymn, no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Pe cel aflat în adâncul pustiei de treimea de sfinți monahi pelerini: Serghie, Ighin și Teofil, pe fiul Romei și Părintele Răsăritului, pe Preacuviosul Macarie, cel cu nume de fericit, care în peșteră s-a nevoit și de doi lei era slujit, să-l fericim, cântând: Bucură-te, cel călăuzit de Arhanghelul Rafail la chipul îngeresc, crinule al curăției și biruitorule al curselor diavolești, înălțime a smereniei, care ai teologhisit atotputernicia Preasfintei Treimi!

english.text: Him whom the three pilgrim monks Sergius, Hyginus and Theophilus found in the depth of the wilderness, the son of Rome and father of the East, the most venerable Macarius whose name means blessed, who struggled in a cave and was served by two lions — let us call him blessed, singing: Rejoice, thou who wast led by the Archangel Raphael to the angelic habit, lily of purity and conqueror of the snares of the devil, height of humility, who didst declare the almighty power of the Most Holy Trinity!
